elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: Inserted covenant: "commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence".

elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.
elements.evidence: Same sentence: "and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate".

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: "professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000".

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: "where Kubient processes any data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Customer, cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000" — the trigger reaches every category of Customer data, not selected named types.

elements.element: Vendor maintains workers' compensation coverage as required by law.
elements.evidence: "and workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable Law".

elements.element: Vendor provides certificates of insurance on request.
elements.evidence: "Kubient shall provide certificates of insurance to Customer on request."

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: E&O set at USD 2,000,000, which exceeds the USD 1,000,000 fallback floor.

elements.element: Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Cyber and privacy liability set at USD 5,000,000, above the USD 2,000,000 fallback floor.

reasons: Position-complete at the preferred level: all six preferred elements appear in a single inserted covenant with the correct amounts, bases (per occurrence / aggregate), the Customer-Data-wide cyber trigger, statutory workers' compensation, and certificates on request.

Minimality holds: the insertion is a concise new paragraph for a genuinely missing clause and correctly omits model-language extras ("at its own expense" and the one-year survival tail), adds no procedures, notice or additional-insured requirements, and deletes or paraphrases nothing in the retained text (p0035 and p0073 are reproduced unchanged).

Intent preserved: the covenant is additive in the general/miscellaneous section, creates no contradiction with the security covenant at p0035 or the third-party-beneficiary/counterparts provision at p0073, and introduces no cross-reference gap.

Drafting nit only (not a defect requiring repair): "applicable Law" is capitalised — if the Agreement contains no definition of "Law", lowercase it to "applicable law" to match the playbook model language and avoid an apparent defined-term reference.

Severity remains low: the gap is a standard-coverage omission rather than a live commercial exposure, and the insertion is a routine addition Kubient can accept or meet at the E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M fallback already flagged in the comment.
